meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Haan — Indian skin tones ke liye **white-cast-free SPF 50/PA++++** sunscreen lena ho, to meri top picks ye hain:

### [Minimalist Light Fluid SPF 50 Face Sunscreen]()
*₹315*

### [The Derma Co 1% Hyaluronic Sunscreen Aqua Gel SPF 50 PA++++]()
*₹278*

### [Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun Rice + Probiotics]()
*₹315*

### [HYPHEN Sunscreen SPF 50]()
*₹549*

### 🥇 Meri #1 pick: Minimalist Light Fluid SPF 50
- **White cast:** generally nahi
- **Finish:** lightweight, natural; oily/combination skin ke liye especially achha
- **Protection:** SPF 50, PA++++
- Current listing mein ~₹315–₹450 range dikh rahi hai. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/collections/spf/products/multi-vitamin-spf-50?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Agar skin oily hai
**The Derma Co 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel SPF 50 PA++++** — lightweight, non-greasy aur white-cast-free option. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/these-7-sunscreens-without-white-cast-work-for-indian-skin-and-summers-101783583467308.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Agar skin dry/normal hai
**Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun** — creamy/moisturising feel, makeup ke neeche bhi comfortable. Indian-skin/summer recommendations mein bhi frequently included hai. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/these-7-sunscreens-without-white-cast-work-for-indian-skin-and-summers-101783583467308.html/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Agar bahut zyada sweat hota hai
**Re'equil Ultra Matte Dry Touch SPF 50 PA++++** — matte finish aur water/sweat resistance ke liye strong choice; Indian summer mein especially useful. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/these-7-sunscreens-without-white-cast-work-for-indian-skin-and-summers-101783583467308.html/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Agar mujhe sirf ek choose karna ho:** 👉 **Minimalist Light Fluid SPF 50**.

Aap mujhe bas bata do **aapki skin oily, dry, combination ya acne-prone hai + budget (₹300/₹500/₹1000)**, main aapke liye **1 exact sunscreen** choose kar dunga.
